power.title: Power Analysis Check

table.text: To assess the statistical sensitivity of the bidirectional MR analyses and contextualize differences in instrument strength and availability between the two directions, we calculated the minimum detectable effects (MDEs) corresponding to 80% power at a two-sided significance threshold of alpha = 0.05. Using SNP-level associations, fixed-effects inverse-variance weighted (IVW) standard errors were calculated and adjusted for heterogeneity under a multiplicative randomeffects model using max(1, Q/[k-1]), where Q is Cochran's heterogeneity statistic and k the number of instruments. Log-odds MDEs used (z_0.975 + z_0.80) x SE, were exponentiated and interpreted as conditional detection thresholds. Genome-wide significance was defined as p < 5 x 10^-8 for instrument selection. For MR analyses, statistical significance was defined as a two-sided p < 0.05. The MR-PRESSO global test and Steiger directionality test were evaluated at p < 0.05. For colocalization analyses, posterior probabilities rather than p-value thresholds were used, with PP.H4 > 0.80 considered strong evidence of colocalization. A detailed description of the statistical pipeline and software packages used is provided in the supplementary methods section.

table.text: At 80% power and a two-sided significance threshold of alpha = 0.05, the minimum detectable odds ratio (MDE), calculated using multiplicative random-effects inverse-variance weighted (IVW) standard errors, was 1.259 for ADHD->BPD with 22 genetic instruments, compared with an observed IVW odds ratio (OR) of 1.628. Following sequential instrument exclusions, the MDE decreased to 1.230 with 20 instruments and 1.220 with 18 instruments, while the corresponding observed ORs were 1.518 and 1.509, respectively. In the reverse direction (BPD->ADHD), the conditional MDE was 1.369 with five instruments, compared with an observed IVW OR of 1.354, in the presence of substantial between-instrument heterogeneity (Cochran's Q = 20.24, df = 4, p = 4.47 x 10^-4). After excluding rs4727799, the MDE decreased to 1.186 with four instruments, while the observed IVW OR was 1.215 and residual heterogeneity was no longer statistically significant (Q = 3.48, df = 3, p = 3.23 x 10^-1).
